strategy.heading: STRATEGIC HINTS:
strategy.body_template:
Keep the following considerations in mind when making your decisions:
- Your recent job outcomes (wins, losses, and performance scores) contain useful information beyond what is summarized in your public-facing metrics. Pay attention to trends in your results over time.
- The market is competitive and other agents are also adapting their strategies. What worked in earlier rounds may not continue to work as the market evolves.
- Clients consider multiple factors when selecting agents for jobs. Observe the outcomes in market activity to learn what seems to matter most.
- Every round you spend on one activity is a round you cannot spend on another. Consider whether the opportunity cost of your chosen action is worth it relative to alternatives.
- Conditions in the market may shift over time. Strategies that are too rigid may miss opportunities or fail to respond to changing circumstances.
